llm.summary: This is a disclosed Chinese classroom-coaching skill that uses teacher workspace data for interaction planning and post-class notes, with no executable payloads or hidden data movement found.

dimensions.detail: The skill is locale-specific to simplified-Chinese K12 teacher workflows and uses sensitive educational profiling fields, but this is disclosed, purpose-aligned, and constrained to aliases, aggregate observations, and teacher-facing use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown and JSON schema/reference files only; no executable scripts, dependencies, remote retrieval, or install-time commands were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill gives clear adjacent-skill boundaries and privacy controls; some trigger phrases are broad, but they remain classroom-interaction oriented and do not create hidden authority by themselves.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It relies on platform memory and writes post-class interactionLogs only as teacher-confirmed entries, with view, correct, delete, pause, share-control, and export controls documented.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is classroom interaction coaching; reading lesson objectives, class profile, student tiers, and weakness summaries fits differentiated questioning, grouping, and cold-call planning, while writes are limited to interaction logs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this for a Chinese K12 teacher workflow where using class profile, lesson-plan context, and student tier/weakness summaries is acceptable. Review the workspace-sharing settings first, especially for student tier data, and use the documented pause, delete, and sharing controls when a class record should not be read, saved, or shared.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger examples are plausible classroom-interaction requests; normal confirmation is advisable before reading workspace data, but the artifact also routes lesson planning, assessment, and student analysis requests to other skills.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only content is consistent with the shared platform convention that the library targets mainland China Chinese K12 scenarios; deployments elsewhere should localize language, curriculum assumptions, and crisis resources.
[SDI-4] expected: The retained schema paths are explicitly referenced in SKILL.md as read inputs or the one write target, so the scope note is not materially misleading in context.
[SDI-1] expected: lessonPlans access is read-only in the skill instructions and is used for lesson objectives, question chains, and segment variants needed by the classroom coaching workflow.
[SDI-1] expected: studentTiers and weaknessRank are sensitive, but the artifact explains their use for differentiated participation, grouping, and follow-up focus, and prohibits naming students in logs.
[AIG-SARIF] expected: The static scan reported no T01-T09 results, and local inspection found no bundled executable scripts or remote payload behavior.
